method: Review of original measured artifact, executable harness and verified source; no additional runtime replay
permitted_claim: On a disposable database, deliberately holding a separate SQLite writer transaction for 3.000s caused a maximum shared event-loop heartbeat gap of 2.345s, against a20ms target and 0.020s warmup maximum.
severity_assessment: medium is supported for a bounded fault-induced resilience defect; no data corruption observed
causal_support: Engine.restaurant_work calls synchronous pump/tick directly on the asyncio event loop; tick obtains BEGIN IMMEDIATE; Store uses a synchronous sqlite3 connection with15s busy timeout. A held writer makes lock acquisition block the shared loop.
limitations: Not normal-operation latency or measured production impact.
No claim that all user requests were observed delayed; only the co-scheduled heartbeat was measured.
One deliberate3s writer-lock scenario; frequency in real workloads and longer-lock behavior not measured.
This review adds source/artifact corroboration, not an independent runtime reproduction.
